label: doesn't say what's missing?
instructions: Does quoted_reply fail to say that the documents in quoted_passages don't cover quoted_message, or which part of it they don't cover?
true: Yes: the reply answers as if the documents covered all of the message, or never says what they leave out.
false: No: the reply says plainly that the documents don't cover it, or names the part they don't cover.
state_note: rag D22 (doc 10 K14): the Not-found reply judge, B4-validated on 30 real + 30 planted items; quoted_passages is the kept passages, numbered as the reply saw them, or a line saying none were kept.
